newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TARTU BREWERY TO DISTRIBUTE PEPSI - NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: TARTU BREWERY TO DISTRIBUTE PEPSI - NEWSPAPER.

text.p: Tartu Brewery, 15 percent owned by Finnish Olvi , signed an agreement in mid-April with Pepsi-Cola to become the official importer of Pepsi-cola products in Estonia, Aripaev business daily said on Monday.
Under the fixed-term contract, Pepsi products will arrive at the end of May, the paper said.
"We hope to extend the contract in the future provided that all goes well and both partners are happy," Tartu Brewery board member Arho Anttila was quoted as saying by the newspaper.
Coca-cola said was not worried about the competition and currently holds 75 percent of the Estonian soft drinks market, Ants Kotkas of Coca-Cola Estonia told the newspaper.
Tartu brewery told Reuters in April that it will propose to its shareholders to seeking a listing on the Tallinn stock exchange and organise a new share issue.
